facts.business: ADC India Communications Limited operates in the communications sector, generating revenue from operations of INR 20,006.36 lakhs in FY2026.

auditor.name: S R B C & CO LLP

key_risks: Significant spikes in raw material costs, particularly copper volatility and fibre availability
Supply chain shocks causing direct cost impacts
Impact of labour laws implementation (Labour Codes) on employee benefit obligations
Contingent liabilities including BMR property tax demand
facts.related_party_note: Trade payables to related parties were INR 1,666.23 lakhs as at March 31, 2026 (INR 720.76 lakhs as at March 31, 2025). Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
